name: Office Ladies™
source:
ORGON® is proud to offer the world’s first Human Resources Training Program™ able to be enjoyed outside of the workplace. Enter the exciting world of HR consultancy and get close and personal with six confident women, driving deep institutional change as part of a fully consensual office simulation.

Solve Workplace Conflicts just like a real middle-aged woman!
Make meaningful choices that affect your story with ORGON® Zeroption™ technology!
Undertake a comprehensive Personalysis™!
Achieve a sense of pride and accomplishment as you unlock different subscriptions!
Find love!
